title: How Pieter Levels hit $1M annual revenue in 4 years with Nomad List and Remote OK
summary: Levels shares a milestone snapshot: after 4 years, two apps (Nomad List and Remote OK) reached $83k+/month, or $1M annualized, with no ad budget and no funding. The stats show a lean setup: one VPS, 208 cron jobs, and about 740 payments per month at a $115 average.

principles.text: Build slowly and profitably: $1M/yr took 4 years, with no funding and no ad budget.
principles.quote: It took 4 years to get here, but we did it:

principles.text: Grow without paid acquisition or outside money; revenue can come from the products themselves.
Keep infrastructure lean: two apps on a single server, heavily automated with cron jobs.
A small portfolio of products can add up: two apps together reached $1M annualized.
